messages:
tess: Heads-up from HelixSystems (marketplace partner): their usage portal shows 15 customers with usage but no matching entitlements in our ledger. They think it's a payload schema mismatch.
omar: any sample payloads?
tess: pasted one sanitized sample in ticket: 
```{
 "partner_customer": "C-4512",
 "meter_units": 4500,
 "period_start": "2025-11-10T00:00:00-08:00",
 "period_end": "2025-11-10T23:59:59-08:00",
 "sku_code": "helix-enterprise-v2"
}```
devon: timezone offsets again. Our ingestion normalizes to UTC and expects period_* fields in Z. If partner sends offsets we parse but there was a parsing bug when offset present + sku suffix.
claire: we recently added a normalization rule that strips suffixes like "-v2"; looks like the rule only ran in batch path, not in streaming webhook path.
omar: easy fix: apply the same normalized mapping in webhook handler and add a metric for "unknown_sku_stream".
billing-bot: reconcile job queued: "reconcile.dryrun" partner=helixsystems period=2025-11-10 (job id r-20251110-07)
devon: plan: 1) run dry-run reconcile for the affected customers 2) fix webhook normalization and deploy canary 3) if dry-run delta < threshold, reprocess streaming rows 4) if > threshold, do full backfill and notify finance
tess: can we do a canary on C-4512 only? also ask Helix to resend those customers as a one-off CSV export.
claire: I'll push the hotfix to staging and add the metric. Omar, can you run the dry-run when it's up?
omar: yes, will run after deploy. Expect results in ~90m.
billing-bot: dry-run started (job id r-dryrun-20251110-07)
tess: noted. tagging this thread as the record. I'll loop in partner-eng if dry-run shows >5% delta.
